requirements.text: Send SMS and email reminders before appointments
Allow customers to book appointments online
Display available services with descriptions and pricing during booking
Provide a calendar-style interface for barbers to update their availability
Track bookings, cancellations, and no-shows with daily and weekly summaries
Provide an option for customers to create accounts to save their details for future bookings
Send immediate booking confirmation via SMS and email
Allow easy cancellation or rescheduling of appointments from confirmation email or customer account
Provide both in-person and online payment options for appointments
Send payment confirmation if online payment is used
Implement a feedback system for customers to leave ratings or comments after appointments
Implement a loyalty program where customers earn points for bookings
Send promotions or special offers to customers
Store customer preferences for personalized experiences
Provide a waitlist feature for customers to join if their desired time slot is booked
The system must be affordable to set up and maintain
The booking system must be user-friendly for both staff and customers
The system must comply with relevant data protection regulations for customer data storage
